opening.quote: Good morning, thank you for calling Tidewell Home, my name is Sanne.
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, as required.

verification.quote: Can I take your full name and either the order number or the postcode on your account, please?
verification.comment: You asked for the full name and order number before accessing the order, which is exactly the verification step.

understanding.quote: So you were charged €49.95 twice for one lamp, and you only want the duplicate payment back, is that right?
understanding.comment: You captured the issue accurately and confirmed it without asking the caller to repeat information they had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: I've refunded the duplicate payment of €49.95 today. Your bank will show it within 3 to 5 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The same-day refund and the 3 to 5 working day bank timeline match the duplicate-charge policy.

process_compliance.quote: Thank you for calling Tidewell, Siobhan, have a lovely day.
process_compliance.comment: No hold occurred and no bank dispute, replacement, or goodwill voucher was involved, so no required steps applied.

communication.quote: I'm sorry about that, being charged twice is really frustrating.
communication.comment: You acknowledged the caller's annoyance directly and stayed polite throughout.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the confirmation email and asked if there was anything else before closing politely.
